notes.title: Marlon's Mystery update: v1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings detectives![/h3] 

Abby and Jared have been itching to bring you a new challenge, and in this new version they have made the [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] available to you.

They have also repaired Jared's grandma's old car and are ready for new operating systems ([b]MacOS[/b] and [b]Linux[/b] versions).

We hope you enjoy the new version.

Made in Mavis

notes.title: Marlon's Mystery patch 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hello, [b]sharp detectives[/b]

A false clue had slipped through the code and we've had to put [b]Abby[/b] and [b]Jared[/b] on the case.
With this patch, [i]the cursor should no longer disappear after using the board[/i].
[b]Thanks[/b] for your messages [b]and enjoy the mysteries[/b].

Made in Mavis 🔎
